verdict.rationale: Slack documents an App Directory with over 2,600 prebuilt apps, including Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, GitHub and Zendesk, that connect "in just a few clicks". A dedicated help article, "Add apps to your Slack workspace", covers installation, and its keywords reference App Directory, Add to Slack, administrators and approving apps. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the admin-specific install and approval workflow (only implied via keywords), independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
